benchmark.name: CladBench v1

summary.en: CladBench evaluates professional built-environment work across regulation, energy, BIM, retrofit, building systems, carbon, and net-zero planning.
summary.zh: CladBench 评估建筑规范、能源、BIM、改造、建筑系统、碳排放和净零规划等建成环境专业能力。

task_format.en: The model completes 536 public questions spanning multiple choice, short answer, rationale, open answer, and ranking formats.
task_format.zh: 模型完成 536 道公开题目，题型包括选择、短答、理由说明、开放回答和排序。

explanation.en: Each item is normalized to 0-1 by its deterministic or rubric scorer, and the headline score is the question-count-weighted mean.
explanation.zh: 每题由固定 deterministic 或 rubric scorer 归一化到 0–1，headline score 是按题目数加权的平均值。

unavailable: T80: not included in the first vertical slice
benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
